title: Luxury Catamaran Sailing Charter of San Diego
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
The Malarky is a 47' Luxury Catamaran, located in the San Diego Bay. Our on-board Captain and Crew will assist you with any needs while you enjoy adventuring San Diego Bay, and the Southern California Coastline. 

Port Lounge

Indoors or outdoors the Malarky has plenty of space to entertain and dine. The indoor dining area is located on the port side, surrounded by comfortable lounge cushions, beautiful wood work, large windows, allowing you to dine in style.

Starboard Lounge

Relax in the spacious lounge area located inside the cabin on the starboard side. Enjoy the beautiful craftsmanship, comfortable lounge cushions, coffee table, inviting window light, calling you to slow down and relax in style.

Aft Deck

Entertain outside with a view and the cool sea air. The aft dining area offers plenty of comfortable shaded seating with a large table.

State Rooms

Equipped with 4 modern decorated State Rooms with flat screen televisions in each - with restrooms on both sides of the boat.
